audience: DeFi lenders and borrowers on Stellar Soroban evaluating liquidation and pool-contagion risks.
problem_statement: DeFi participants using pooled lending protocols face systemic contagion, where sudden liquidations or bad debt from one asset pool can compromise the solvency and collateral of unrelated positions.
angle: With Blend holding $157,161,882 in TVL dominating Stellar credit while Soroswap holds only $1,238,140, shared pool exposure creates concentrated contagion risk; moving to isolated accounts prevents cascade liquidations, though current on-chain evidence is limited to these TVL figures and ledger fee metrics (capacity usage at 0.08) rather than specific contagion loss data.
